title: Monotone graph property
statement: For a natural number $v$, a Boolean-valued graph property on the $v$-vertex set is monotone if whenever $G\le H$ and the property holds for $G$, it also holds for $H$.
hypotheses_covered: The property is a Boolean-valued function on encoded graphs on the $v$-vertex set
